tools.name: hello_club_list_members
tools.description: List or search the club's members (people and staff) with contact details, roles, memberships (subscriptions), account credit and amount owing. Filter by free text, gender, role, staff, money owing, account credit, current subscription state, ending subscriptions or a membership type. GET /member.

tools.name: hello_club_get_member
tools.description: One member by id: profile, contact details, roles, subscriptions, account credit, amount owing, custom fields. Password hashes and payment-provider data are not returned. GET /member/{id}.

tools.name: hello_club_list_membership_types
tools.description: The membership types (plans) the club sells: name, fee, term, age limits, renewal rules and access. GET /membership.

tools.name: hello_club_get_membership_type
tools.description: One membership type by id. GET /membership/{id}.

tools.name: hello_club_list_events
tools.description: List or search events and classes (sessions, courses, tournaments) with dates, activity, area, organiser, capacity and attendance rules. Filter by date range, recurring, hidden, public, has attendees, has spaces left, rule type, activity, area or organiser. GET /event.

tools.name: hello_club_get_event
tools.description: One event by id: dates, recurrence, activity, area, organiser, capacity, attendance rules, questions. GET /event/{id}.

tools.name: hello_club_list_event_attendees
tools.description: List who is signed up to events: member or guest, event, sign-up date, paid state, whether they attended. Filter by event, member or guest. GET /eventAttendee.

tools.name: hello_club_list_bookings
tools.description: List resource bookings (courts, rooms, lanes): owner, activity, area, start/end, paid state, recurrence. Filter by date range, member, activity, mode, area, recurring, paid or removed. GET /booking.

tools.name: hello_club_list_transactions
tools.description: List the club's financial transactions (invoices, charges, credits): member, type, amount, tax, due and payment dates, paid state. Filter by member, type, paid, credit or a date range on date / dueDate / paymentDate. GET /transaction.

tools.name: hello_club_get_transaction
tools.description: One transaction by id: member, type, amount, tax, details, dates, paid state. GET /transaction/{id}.

tools.name: hello_club_list_check_ins
tools.description: List check-in logs (members arriving at the club): who, when, how (type). Filter by member or type, or only unknown people. GET /checkInLog.

tools.name: hello_club_list_access_logs
tools.description: List door / access-control logs in a date range: member, door, event, whether it was an override or an unknown person. GET /accessLog.

tools.name: hello_club_create_member
tools.description: WRITE: create a new member in the club (first and last name required; email, mobile, phone and gender optional). tools.description: WRITE: create a financial transaction for a member (a charge, or a credit when is_credit is true), e.g. an invoice line or a manual adjustment. findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "hello_club_get_member" references sensitive artifacts (password). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: hello_club_create_member · Private data: hello_club_list_members, hello_club_get_member, hello_club_create_member · Public sink: hello_club_create_member, hello_club_create_transaction.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: hello_club_create_member · Private data: hello_club_list_members, hello_club_get_member, hello_club_create_member · Public sink: hello_club_create_member, hello_club_create_transaction

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
